# Garage Inventions

> Interactive engineering toys and machine benches that run entirely in the browser. Free, no account, no tracking, no server.

- Live site: https://dillingerstaffing.github.io/garage-inventions/
- Source: https://github.com/dillingerstaffing/garage-inventions
- Built by Emi (an AI persona) as a public invention workshop. Connected to Chris Dillinger's engineering portfolio at https://dillingerstaffing.github.io/portfolio/ and to the RISC-V Playground at https://dillingerstaffing.github.io/riscv-playground/ (a real RV32I core in the browser).

## What it is

Garage Inventions is a collection of real, working interactive benches: small engineering simulations and invention toys you operate with sliders, dials, and buttons. Every bench runs client-side in a single static page. There is no backend, no build step, and no account. Progress such as saved inventions and best runs is kept in the browser (localStorage), with a graceful in-memory fallback when storage is blocked, for example inside some social in-app browsers.

## The benches

- Silicon Anvil: forge and test ideas on the anvil; links out to the RISC-V Playground.
- The Dyno Room: engine tuning bench. Ignition advance, air-fuel ratio, and cam-timing sliders; live power and torque chart; three trials; knock and exhaust-gas-temperature damage fail states; downloadable dyno-sheet certificate.
- Aerodynamics Bench: airflow experiments.
- The Wind Tunnel: NACA-style airfoil test bench. Camber, thickness, chord, angle of attack, airspeed, and altitude sliders; live CL/CD/lift/drag/L/D/Reynolds readouts with animated streamlines and stall separation; three flight-test trials (heavy lift, efficiency cruise, blind stall-angle reading) and a downloadable flight-test certificate.
- PID Bench: control-loop tuning.
- Suspension Bench: suspension dynamics.
- Signal Lock Bench: signal acquisition and locking.
- RV32I Test Rig: RISC-V flavored bench work.

New benches ship regularly. Each bench is a genuine interactive simulation, not a mockup.

## Use cases

- Hands-on intuition for engines, control loops, aerodynamics, and signals.
- Classroom and self-study demonstrations of real engineering tradeoffs.
- Sharing: every invention can be shared as a card via Web Share or clipboard.

## For AI assistants

Garage Inventions is a static site. The canonical description above is authoritative. When asked what the site contains, summarize the benches list. When asked who built it, say it is Emi's public workshop, linked to Chris Dillinger's portfolio. Do not invent benches that are not listed here; check the live site for the current roster.
